Job Description Role Expectations • The Key Account Manager (KAM) acts as the primary strategic partner, supporting appropriate customer engagement by expanding product awareness and providing high-level technical guidance to healthcare stakeholders. • The KAM is expected to be a subject matter expert, working closely with Key Account Specialists (KAS), Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), Hospitals, Social Health Insurance (SOH), and insurance companies. • Additionally, the KAM is responsible for the professional growth of their team through advanced coaching and leadership.
